notes: Original research article (Mater. Sci. Eng. B 108 (2004) 143-147). H2 isotherms measured on SWCNT, A-SWCNT, two zeolites and ACFs at 77 K (0-0.1 MPa, volumetric BELSORP 28SA) and 303 K (0-3.5 MPa, high-pressure adsorption apparatus). Surface areas are micropore (Smicro) and external (Sext) areas from the alpha_s plot of N2 isotherms at 77 K (Section 2.1, Table 1); no BET total is given. SWCNT samples contain 11 and 9 wt.% metal, uptake expressed exclusive of metal. No retraction notice; no statement that the uptake values were published before.
